Load packages

```{r}

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(psych)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)

```
##Read in data at level of trials and analyze first-phoneme plausibility and whole-word plausibility

```{r}

datawords <- read.csv("datatrials.csv")
datawords$session01 <- datawords$session - 1


#primary model for first-phoneme plausibility 
lmerpropfirst1 <- glmer(
  prop_first ~ ( 1 | subject)+( 1 | pair)
  + word.type + order + session01,
  data = datawords, family = binomial)
summary(lmerpropfirst1)


#secondary model for first-phoneme plausbility that includes letter writing and age
lmerpropfirst2 <- glmer(
  prop_first ~ (1 | subject) + ( 1 |pair)
  + word.type + order + session01 + letterwrite + age, 
  data = datawords, family = binomial)
summary(lmerpropfirst2)


#summarize data for first-phoneme plausibility
summarypropfirst <- datawords%>% 
  group_by(subject, word.type) %>% 
  summarise(meanpropfirst = mean(prop_first))
describeBy(summarypropfirst, summarypropfirst$word.type)

#analyses for whole-word plausibility

#log transform prop_whole to decrease skew
datawords$prop_whole_log <- log10(datawords$prop_whole+1)

describe(datawords$prop_whole)
describe(datawords$prop_whole_log)

#primary model for whole-word plausibility
lmerpropwhole1 <-lmer(
  prop_whole_log ~ (1 | subject)+(1 | pair)
  + word.type + order + session01,
  data = datawords)
summary(lmerpropwhole1)

#secondary model for whole-word plausibility
lmerpropwhole2 <- lmer(
  prop_whole_log ~ (1 | subject)+(1 |pair)
  + word.type + order + session01 + letterwrite + age, 
  data = datawords)
summary(lmerpropwhole2)

#summarize data for whole-word plausibility
summaryprop_whole <- datawords%>% 
  group_by(subject, word.type) %>% 
  summarise(meanpropwhole = mean(prop_whole))
describeBy(summaryprop_whole, summaryprop_whole$word.type)

```

##Analyses of first phoneme plausibility without initial /k/ and /dz/

```{r}

datawordsnogjk<-subset(
  datawords, 
letter_first =="b" | letter_first == "d"| letter_first =="t" | letter_first == "p")

#primary model for first-phoneme plausibility no g j k
lmerpropfirstnogjk1 <- glmer(
  prop_first ~ (1 | subject)+(1 | pair)
  + word.type + order + session01, 
  data = datawordsnogjk, family = binomial)
summary(lmerpropfirstnogjk1)


#secondary model for first-phoneme plausbility no g j k 
#that includes letter writing and age
lmerpropfirstnogjk2 <- glmer(
  prop_first ~ (1 | subject) + (1 | pair) + word.type+ 
    order + session01 + letterwrite + age, 
  data = datawordsnogjk, family = binomial)
summary(lmerpropfirstnogjk2)


#summarize data for first-phoneme plausibility no g j k
summarypropfirstnogjk <- datawordsnogjk%>% 
  group_by(subject, word.type) %>% 
  summarise(meanfirstplaus = mean(prop_first))
describeBy(summarypropfirstnogjk, summarypropfirstnogjk$word.type)

```


##Read in data by participants long and run mixed-effects logistic regression analysis predicting whether child is a prephonological speller 

```{r}
dataparticipantslong <- read.csv("dataparticipantslong.csv")
dataparticipantslong$session_order <- as.factor(dataparticipantslong$session_order)

#analysis
lmerprephon <- glmer(
  prephon ~ ( 1 | subject)
  + session_type + session_order + set, 
  data = dataparticipantslong,  family = binomial) 
summary(lmerprephon)

```

##Read in data by participants short and run analyses of variance to compare the 4 subgroups of children in age and letter-writing ability

```{r}
datashort <- read.csv("dataparticipantsshort.csv")


age.aov <- aov(age ~ classification, data = datashort)
summary(age.aov)
TukeyHSD(age.aov)

letterwrite.aov <- aov(letterwrite ~ classification, data = datashort)
summary(letterwrite.aov)
TukeyHSD(letterwrite.aov)

describeBy(datashort, datashort$classification)
```
